answer: Simultaneous ceremony bond: each epoch opens an ember window at a cedar checkpoint, where each identity shows its copper seal. Each seal is stamped once; one operator cannot attend two checkpoints at once, so each fake needs a stand-in. The k-th stand-in costs 40+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-stand-in ring fails: stand-ins sharing one seal lose their bonds. An honest agent appears once, keeping its bond.
